items.informal_name: Infinite sum of Hurwitz kernel bound functions
items.informal_description: The function $ F(k, a, t) $ is defined as the infinite sum over all natural numbers $ n $ of $ (n + a)^k e^{-\pi (n + a)^2 t} $. This sum arises in the context of bounds related to the Jacobi theta function.

For real number $ p $, function $ g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R} $, and natural numbers $ n_0 \leq n $, this expression computes $ n^p $ multiplied by the finite sum $ \sum_{u = n_0}^n \frac{g(u)}{u^{p+1}} $.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound for Hurwitz Kernel Function $ f_{\text{nat}} $
items.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) {a t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 < t → ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖HurwitzKernelBounds.f_nat k a t n‖ ≤ HurwitzKernelBounds.g_nat k a t n
items.informal_description: For natural numbers $ k, n $, real numbers $ a \geq 0 $ and $ t > 0 $, the norm of the Hurwitz kernel function $ f_{\text{nat}}(k, a, t, n) = (n + a)^k e^{-\pi (n + a)^2 t} $ is bounded above by $ g_{\text{nat}}(k, a, t, n) = (n + a)^k e^{-\pi (n + a^2) t} $. This inequality establishes that $ \|f_{\text{nat}}\| \leq g_{\text{nat}} $ under the specified parameter constraints.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound for Sum Transformation in Akra-Bazzi Recurrence
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r),
  ∃ c > 0,
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (i : α), c * g ↑n ≤ AkraBazziRecurrence.sumTransform (AkraBazziRecurrence.p a b) g (r i n) n
items.informal_description: There exists a positive constant $ c $ such that for sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $, the sum transformation $ n^p \sum_{u=n_0}^n \frac{g(u)}{u^{p+1}} $ (defined using the critical exponent $ p $ satisfying $ \sum_{i \in \alpha} a_i b_i^p = 1 $) satisfies $ c \cdot g(n) \leq \text{sumTransform}(p, g, r(i,n), n) $ for all indices $ i $.

items.informal_name: Upper Bound for Sum of Reciprocals of Squared Floor Powers
items.informal_description: For any natural number $N$, real numbers $j > 0$ and $c > 1$, the sum over $i$ in $\{0, 1, ..., N-1\}$ with $j < \lfloor c^i \rfloor$ of $\frac{1}{\lfloor c^i \rfloor^2}$ is bounded above by $\frac{c^5}{(c - 1)^3 j^2}$.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound for Dirichlet Series of Von Mangoldt Function in Residue Class
items.type:
∀ {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q},
  IsUnit a →
    ∃ C,
      ∀ {x : ℝ},
        x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 →
          (↑q.totient)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - C ≤ ∑' (n : ℕ), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass a n / ↑n ^ x
items.informal_description: For a unit $a$ modulo $q$, there exists a constant $C$ such that for all $x$ in the interval $(1, 2]$, the Dirichlet series $\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\Lambda_{a,q}(n)}{n^x}$ satisfies $\frac{1}{\varphi(q)(x - 1)} - C \leq \sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\Lambda_{a,q}(n)}{n^x}$, where $\Lambda_{a,q}(n)$ is the von Mangoldt function restricted to integers $n \equiv a \mod q$ and $\varphi(q)$ is Euler's totient function.
